lessons.title: Specifications & repository context
lessons.description: Specify, inspect and verify AI-generated changes.
lessons.conceptOverview: Give a coding assistant acceptance criteria, relevant interfaces and repository conventions. Scope context to the problem while keeping secrets out. A specification should state observable behavior and edge cases. Ask for a concrete patch and evidence rather than assuming a plausible explanation means correct code.

sections.title: Try it yourself
sections.content: Write a specification for a parser with malformed-input behavior. Give the assistant a failing example and inspect which files its patch changes.

commonMistakes: A convincing explanation proves a generated patch is correct.

lessons.title: Debugging, tests & review
lessons.description: Specify, inspect and verify AI-generated changes.
lessons.conceptOverview: Reproduce the failure before editing. Use tests that exercise observable behavior and can fail for a plausible incorrect implementation. Review generated code for injection, authorization, error handling and dependency risks. Refactoring should preserve behavior, verified with regression checks.

sections.title: Try it yourself
sections.content: Ask for a fix to a failing boundary case, then test empty, malformed and oversized inputs. Identify a test that merely repeats the implementation and replace it.

commonMistakes: Tests generated by the same assistant are sufficient proof of correctness.

lessons.title: Agentic coding & Git workflows
lessons.description: Specify, inspect and verify AI-generated changes.
lessons.conceptOverview: Coding agents can plan and execute multi-step changes, but need a bounded task and reviewable diffs. Isolated branches or worktrees reduce collisions. Check repository status before edits, preserve unrelated changes and review generated commands before destructive operations. Evaluate task completion using behavior and maintainability.

sections.title: Try it yourself
sections.content: Run a small specification-driven change in an isolated checkout. Review the diff, run relevant tests and write a rollback plan before merging.

commonMistakes: An agent may discard unrelated changes to simplify its task.
